description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'EndpointAwareReport' which extends another interface 'Report'. It specifies methods related to preparing filter parameters, validation rules, and access checks for report endpoints within a Human Resource Management system. It is part of the OrangeHRM project and facilitates creating reports that are aware of endpoint context.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares a FilterParams object from request parameters based on endpoint data.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns a collection of validation rules for filter parameters based on the endpoint context.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report is accessible at the given endpoint; throws ForbiddenException if not.
